# Android Club VIT Bhopal

> Official student developer chapter at VIT Bhopal University (established 2017). Focused on native Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Kotlin Multiplatform, Flutter, Material Design 3, full-stack web engineering, UI/UX, and on-device AI/IoT.

## Quick Facts

- Organization: Android Club, VIT Bhopal University
- Location: Kothri Kalan, Sehore, Madhya Pradesh 466114, India
- Website: https://androidclub.tech
- GitHub: https://github.com/Android-Club-VIT-Bhopal
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/android-club-vit-bhopal/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/androidclub.vitb/
- Contact Email: androidclub@vitbhopal.ac.in
- Faculty Advisors: Dr. Chandan Kumar Behera, Dr. Adarsh Patel, Dr. G Ganeshan
- Scale: 1,000+ community members, 40+ campus events, 12 active teams

## Engineering Pillars & Tracks

- Native Android: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines/Flow, Room, Material 3
- Cross-Platform: Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), Supabase
- Software Development Cell (SDC): Next.js, TypeScript, web portals, backend APIs, recruitment infrastructure
- Research & Development (R&D): TensorFlow Lite on-device inference, ESP32 microcontrollers, Bluetooth LE telemetry, security tooling
- Design & Content: Material You UI/UX tokens in Figma, graphics, media production, technical articles

## Featured Student Projects

- CampusOrbit: Real-time VIT Bhopal bus tracker and campus shuttle ETA monitor
- MessMate VIT: Daily hostel menu tracker and student rating companion built with KMP and Compose
- RoboRover BLE: 60Hz Bluetooth LE telemetry controller for ESP32 robotics hardware
- CodeArena Edge: Offline-capable campus coding contest runner and submission dashboard
- DroidWallet Preview: Campus reward ledger prototype for Droid Coins (DRD)

## Droid Coins (DRD) Student Rewards

Students earn DRD at campus workshops, Hackathons/Arenas, verified @vitbhopal.ac.in onboarding, and merged pull requests on chapter repositories. Coins redeem for stickers, woven lanyards, hackathon passes, and chapter apparel.

## Joining Android Club VIT Bhopal

VIT Bhopal students apply during recruitment drives through https://androidclub.tech/#join across Technical tracks (Android, SDC, R&D, UI/UX) or Non-Technical tracks (Events, Operations, Design, Content, Media, PR & Outreach, Finance).
